items.title: Link the verified payments profile in Play Console (finishes the org conversion)
items.detail: Google emailed Nov 2 at 10:44 AM CT: the new payments profile is verified and just needs linking. Open Play Console, Developer account, About you, and choose Link payments profile. Until you do, the account stays Personal and Wrangle can't publish as Rocko Development LLC.

items.title: Wrangle Play listing: confirm auto-renew and cancel wording

items.title: Render: wop_systems memory restarts and bandwidth past 70%
items.detail: wop_systems auto-restarted after hitting its memory limit Nov 1 (3:42 AM CT) and Nov 2 (3:47 AM CT). New Nov 3 (6:10 AM CT): the team has used over 70% of the Hobby plan's 5 GB monthly bandwidth. Check memory use, traffic, or the plan size.

items.detail: Wiro approved the Ignition tier ($200 credits) on Nov 1, and a thank-you reply went out Nov 2. Redeem the code from the Wiro thread in the company Gmail before Wrangle's AI testing starts.
